chunks: Jabir narrated from Abu Ja'far عليه السلام that he said:

Regarding women, do not consult them in confidential matters, and do not obey them in matters concerning relatives. When a woman grows old, the better half of her qualities departs and the worse half remains: her beauty fades, her tongue becomes sharper, and her womb becomes barren. And when a man grows old, the worse half of his qualities departs and the better half remains: his intellect becomes firm, his judgment becomes stronger, and his ignorance decreases.

key_terms.النِّسَاءِ: women, the subject under discussion in the hadith

ai.seo_question: What does Imam al-Baqir عليه السلام say about consulting women and the effects of old age on women and men?
ai.summary: This hadith presents an ethical statement about consultation, kinship matters, and perceived changes that accompany old age in women and men. It contrasts the effects of aging on each, describing the loss of beauty and fertility in women and the strengthening of intellect and judgment in men.
